description: This file implements the HttpClient class responsible for handling HTTP file downloads using libcurl, including initialization, cleanup, download management, progress tracking, and data writing.

classes.name: HttpClient
classes.description: A class providing HTTP client functionalities for downloading files, tracking progress, and managing curl resources.

methods.name: HttpClient()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the curl handle.

methods.name: ~HttpClient()
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up the curl handle.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads a file from a specified URL to a local filename with optional rate limiting.

methods.name: progressCb
methods.description: Callback function to track download progress.

methods.name: write_data
methods.description: Callback function to write downloaded data to a file.
